title: 康卡斯特分拆NBC环球股价大涨媒体巨头为何瘦身？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Comcast has announced plans to spin off NBC Universal in Sky.
segments.zh: 康卡斯特宣布计划剥离NBC环球和天空电视台。

segments.en: It will be a new media unit and separating it from its telecom business.
segments.zh: 新成立的媒体部门将与电信业务分离。

segments.en: Let's discuss with Bloomberg's Kelsey Griffiths. Kelsey, this isn't the first deal in recent times that Comcast has done, spinning off the Versaunt unit.
segments.zh: 与彭博社的Kelsey Griffiths讨论。Kelsey，这不是康卡斯特近期第一次剥离业务。

segments.en: What has been the thinking behind spinning off NBC Universal and Sky this time?
segments.zh: 这次剥离NBC环球和天空电视台背后的考量是什么？

segments.en: Well, I was just listening to the investor call as Mike Kavanaugh and the Comcast Executive Suite gave us some updates on why they're doing this.
segments.zh: 我刚刚听了市场参与者电话会议，Mike Kavanaugh和管理层解释了原因。

segments.en: And they've said, look, we have multiple businesses that are really just focus on different priorities. For a while, scale seems like the best option.
segments.zh: 他们表示，多个业务有不同的优先事项，此前规模似乎是最好选择。

segments.en: Now that we've seen the media businesses and the broadband business get more competitive, it seems like it makes more sense to split those companies off and focus on them each doing
segments.zh: 如今媒体和宽带业务竞争加剧，分拆后各自专注优势更合理。

segments.en: what they do well individually. Does some aspect of this also just have to do with the value of these media business?
segments.zh: 这是否也与这些媒体业务的价值有关？

segments.en: I mean, Versaunt has declined about 21 percent since it was spun off.
I mean, might NBC Universal and Sky meet a similar fate, Kelsey?
segments.zh: NBC环球和天空电视台会遭遇类似命运吗，Kelsey？

segments.en: Now that's something that I think we're continuing to look at. Overall, Comcast has definitely been sort of struggling with their share price, especially over the last year.
segments.zh: 这是我们持续关注的事情。总体来看，康卡斯特的股价在过去一年里确实承压。

segments.en: If you look at the broadband business, which is kind of my area of expertise, they've also been trying to look at how they can stem some of these customer losses.
segments.zh: 以宽带业务为例，这也是我的专长领域，他们一直在想办法减少客户流失。

segments.en: And yes, they are just deciding that a different structure makes sense here for the financial good of the business.
segments.zh: 是的，他们认定调整结构对业务财务更有利。
